overview: This single-page Department of State list-of-papers entry concerns Japanese wireless-telegraph regulations. It records a note dated July 23, 1940, associated with “Japan #4865 (1964),” about obtaining or applying for a permit for a shortwave radio, and supplies the related decimal-file reference 223.861/910.

subfiles.title: List-of-papers entry concerning a shortwave-radio permit
subfiles.about: An index entry records a note concerning an application or request for a Japanese shortwave-radio permit.
subfiles.summary: The Department of State’s list of papers identifies an item under “Wireless Telegraph Laws - Japan.” The entry is dated July 23, 1940, and cites “Japan #4865 (1964).” Its partially garbled description concerns a permit for a shortwave radio and refers researchers to file number 223.861/910.

interest: Although only an administrative index page, this document is useful for tracing the regulation of private or official shortwave-radio equipment in wartime Japan. Its cross-reference to 223.861/910 and its numbered Japan item may lead to the underlying note or correspondence, while also illustrating how State Department records on communications regulation were indexed across decimal-file subjects.
